requirements.title: Transport-independent canonical semantics
requirements.statement: Supported HTTP/MCP/CLI/GraphQL surfaces use the same canonical IDs, applicability/status semantics and mutation authority.

requirements.title: Bounded pagination and continuation
requirements.statement: List/graph APIs expose deterministic bounds, continuation and incomplete-state semantics; truncation cannot masquerade as complete data.

requirements.title: Idempotent/replay-safe mutations where required
requirements.statement: Create/import/proposal operations define replay/idempotency behavior and do not create duplicate canonical truth on retry.

requirements.title: Versioned machine contracts
requirements.statement: Public machine contracts expose version/compatibility behavior sufficient for clients to distinguish breaking semantic changes.

requirements.title: Capability discovery
requirements.statement: Clients can determine supported optional capabilities/projections/integrations rather than assuming every adapter is mounted.

requirements.title: Product/project authorization boundaries
requirements.statement: Authenticated identities cannot read or mutate product/project scopes outside granted authority.

requirements.title: Secrets and credentials are not product evidence
requirements.statement: Secrets/credentials are handled through bounded secret mechanisms and are never stored/exposed as ordinary graph/evidence payloads.

requirements.title: Untrusted content cannot grant authority
requirements.statement: Imported text, documents, model output or prompt content cannot self-authorize mutations, evidence admission or policy changes.

requirements.title: Redaction preserves explainability
requirements.statement: Sensitive payload redaction removes protected content while retaining permitted identity/provenance/tombstone links needed for historical explanation.

requirements.title: Atomic canonical mutations
requirements.statement: Multi-record canonical changes either commit coherently or expose failure without partially accepted product truth.

requirements.title: Concurrent mutation conflict semantics
requirements.statement: Concurrent writes use explicit conflict/version rules and cannot silently lose accepted product changes.

requirements.title: Backup and restore preserve canonical history
requirements.statement: Supported backup/restore recovers product identities, baselines, relations, observations, reuse/invalidation history and required provenance.

requirements.title: Crash/restart consistency
requirements.statement: Interrupted writes/restarts cannot produce a silently accepted half-baseline or orphan evidence state.

requirements.title: Performance optimization cannot change truth semantics
requirements.statement: Caching, virtualization, culling, indexing, progressive loading and alternate renderers may change latency/resource use but not canonical product meaning.

requirements.title: Performance claims bind benchmark profile
requirements.statement: Scale/latency/resource claims identify candidate, dataset shape/size, environment, operation and metric rather than using context-free percentages.

requirements.title: Explicit degradation/fallback
requirements.statement: When scale/resource limits prevent full rendering/query, interfaces expose degraded/partial state and a recovery/continuation path instead of false completeness.

requirements.title: Continuation is semantically stable
requirements.statement: Paginated/progressive traversal over a stable baseline yields deterministic non-duplicated/non-missing canonical coverage under its declared ordering/snapshot rules.

requirements.title: Optional adapters are replaceable
requirements.statement: Collectors, graph stores, caches, object stores, analytics and ML integrations sit behind semantic boundaries so replacement does not redefine product truth.

requirements.title: Optional integration failure is isolated
requirements.statement: Failure of an optional integration is surfaced with bounded impact and does not corrupt core local product truth.

requirements.title: External facts retain source provenance
requirements.statement: Facts imported from external services retain source identity/time/version/confidence as applicable and can be invalidated/reconciled.

requirements.title: Versioned AgilePlus federation contract
requirements.statement: AgilePlus handoff identifies work/assignment/candidate/evaluation/evidence revisions and contract version so Tracera can independently admit applicability.

requirements.title: Federation failure preserves both authorities
requirements.statement: Tracera or AgilePlus unavailability does not silently mutate the other system's canonical truth; pending/retry state is explicit.

requirements.title: Registry projection is revision-bound
requirements.statement: PhenoRegistry projection identifies the Tracera contract/status revision it summarizes so stale projection can be detected.

requirements.title: Registry cannot override repo-local truth
requirements.statement: Registry edits/summaries cannot silently replace a newer accepted repo-local Tracera baseline/contract.
